name: VoidRoom
summary:
Make a place. Find your people.

VoidRoom is a social VR game where you can hang out, shape your own space and try something new.

**Make yourself at home** Customise your avatar’s face, hair, glasses and colours, then save your look to your VRC.LOL account. Start in your personal room or visit the Clubhouse.

**Meet and chat** Join other players in shared rooms. Talk through voice chat or use the controller keyboard for room text chat.

**Build with the Maker Pen** Place, move, resize and colour objects. E
